subject: Request: temporary assurance addendum to cover post-report period (AvalonTech)
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@avalontech.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@avalontech.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for short assurance addendum to cover post-report period

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week — AvalonTech is moving quickly and we're down to procurement / security sign-off. One outstanding item from our security team: can Redwood provide a short assurance addendum that covers the period after your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2026-09-30) through today?

Scope: the addendum should be a one-page attestation confirming there have been no control changes material to the scope in the following areas since 2026-10-01: access controls, incident response, encryption/KMS, and data retention. Our board-level auditors prefer a signed PDF with a contact for follow-up.

Timeline: we need the addendum by EOD Friday (2026-11-27) to stay on our procurement cadence. If there are standard artifacts you can share (evidence links, KMS/HSM summary), that would be helpful but not strictly required.

I've attached a short procurement packet and our security checklist for reference (see attachment stub).

Sincerely,
Sara Li
Senior Security Program Manager
AvalonTech
Attachments: AvalonTech_Security_Request_20261125.pdf
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@avalontech.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for short assurance addendum to cover post-report period

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear note and the packet. We're aligned on the request and can provide a concise signed addendum that summarizes continuity for the controls you listed. A few quick clarifying questions so we produce exactly what your auditors need: 

1) Do your auditors expect the addendum to reference the original SOC 2 report by date/report ID, or is a generic continuity statement sufficient?
2) For KMS/HSM: do you need specific vendor certificates (e.g., HSM model) or just a summary of key-management controls and whether keys are customer- or service-managed?
3) Signature: do you prefer a named signatory (I can have our Head of Security sign) or an e-signed cover page (DocuSign)?

I'll loop in Neha (security) and Laura (compliance) to draft the language. Ben — can you confirm the AvalonTech PO/contract reference (deal id) so we can include it on the cover?

We aim to have a first draft by Thursday morning and a signed PDF by EOD Friday.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0192
Attachments: (none)
From: Sara Li <sara.li@avalontech.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@avalontech.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for short assurance addendum to cover post-report period

Ava,

Thanks, that timeline works. Quick answers: 
- Please reference the SOC 2 report dated 2026-09-30 (our audit team will match the period).
- KMS summary is fine — we don't need vendor certs at this stage, a short note on HSM usage + whether Redwood rotates keys and the separation of duties will be sufficient.
- DocuSign is fine for signature.

Contract/PO: procurement@avalontech.com will issue a PO once we complete security sign-off. No PO number yet. If you can include 'AvalonTech - procurement review' on the addendum that will help.

I've re-attached the checklist for Neha/Laura.

Sara
Attachment: AvalonTech_Security_Request_20261125.pdf
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Request for short assurance addendum to cover post-report period

Team, forwarding AvalonTech's request. They want a concise signed addendum referencing our SOC 2 report (ended 2026-09-30) covering 2026-10-01 through today, and a short KMS/HSM summary. Deadline: EOD Friday (2026-11-27).

Neha — can you draft a one-page addendum and a ~200-300 word KMS summary that we can attach? Please ensure the addendum explicitly names the control areas: access control, incident response, encryption/KMS, data retention, and states whether there were any material changes during the post-report period. Keep the phrasing auditor-friendly (e.g., 'to the best of our knowledge, no material control changes affecting the scope occurred between...').

Laura — once the draft is ready, can you quick-review for legal/compliance phrasing and confirm signatory (Head of Security vs. CEO)?

Ben — flag if you want me to hold for the PO or proceed with DocuSign; AvalonTech said PO pending but prefer DocuSign for speed. Deal id is AV-2026-4421 if you need to attach.

I'll coordinate the signature routing once we have a final draft.

Thanks — Ava
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@avalontech.com>
Cc: ava.chen@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood temporary assurance addendum (AvalonTech)

Sara,

Attached is the requested Temporary Assurance Addendum and a short KMS/HSM overview. Summary below: 

- Addendum: Redwood Inference confirms that, to the best of our knowledge, there were no material changes to the scope or operation of controls relevant to AvalonTech's security review in the control domains of Access Controls, Incident Response, Encryption/KMS, and Data Retention for the period 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-27. The addendum references our SOC 2 Type II report covering the period ending 2026-09-30 and is signed by our Head of Security.

- KMS/HSM summary: we operate a hybrid key management model where customer data encryption keys are service-managed within an industry-standard HSM (FIPS 140-2 compliant). Keys are rotated on a quarterly schedule, dual-personnel access is enforced for key management operations, and production key material is never exported.

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_Temporary_Assurance_Addendum_20261127.pdf, KMS_HSM_Overview.pdf

Next steps: we can route this via DocuSign on the link below if you prefer an e-signature flow. If your auditors need additional artifacts (e.g., control logs or truncated evidence), please let us know and we can scope a follow-up.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embedded/12345-avalon-ds
Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-avalon-evidence

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
